Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

%TEI.front.dtd

TEI.front.dtd defines the file in which tags for front matter are defined.
Note

This parameter entity is used in each base tag set to include the front-matter tags, which are common to all bases.
Declaration <!ENTITY % TEI.front.dtd PUBLIC '-//TEI P4//ELEMENTS Front Matter//EN' 'teifron2.dtd' >
See further 7.4 Front Matter
